details.s: Angrod was a Ñoldorin Elf, the second son of Finarfin and lord of the Ñoldor of Dorthonion. He was the father of Orodreth and subsequently grandfather of the famed Gil-galad.
f: Ñoldor (House of Finarfin), Falmari (House of Olwë)
